cases.name: Ashley Jenea Minatel
cases.about:
Her obituary said, "Ashely graduated from Manuel High School and worked as a hairdresser before becoming a stay at home mom to daughter, Hunter Sue.  She is survived by her mother and step-father, Sue and Bob Blazek; her father and step-mother, Gary and Nan Minatel; her daughter, Hunter Sue; brother, Josh Minatel; sister, Lindsay Minatel; step-sister, Tiffany Conover; grandparents, aunts, uncles, cousins, a nephew and a great aunt. She will be deeply missed."

https://www.legacy.com/obituaries/name/ashley-minatel-obituary?pid=188251083
cases.narrative: Shot three times — in the chest, head and face.
